findings.title: New restriction would cover existing clients: Trustline NBFC, PayTrack Technologies
findings.explanation: Potential conflict — not a breach determination. The restriction in §8.1 reaches businesses AtliQ already serves under signed contracts: Trustline NBFC (Active client — collections analytics MSA (USD 48k), until 14 Aug 2027); PayTrack Technologies (Active client — transaction analytics & fraud/anomaly detection MSA (USD 71k), until 21 Jan 2027). Signing would mean breaching this agreement by continuing that work, or abandoning those clients. Restrictions like this belong in the commitments register — this is the 'what have we promised not to do' problem from the 22 Sep meeting.
findings.contract_quote: In order to protect the Confidential Information, the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

findings.title: Called a 'Mutual' NDA, but it is one-way — only AtliQ is bound
findings.explanation: The title and recitals say mutual, but the operative terms are not: Confidential Information is defined as information disclosed by the other party to AtliQ, AtliQ is defined as the 'Recipient', and every obligation, remedy and covenant runs against AtliQ only. AtliQ's own architecture, methods and pricing shared in the walkthrough would have no protection. Karandeep's rule is 'NDAs → just sign if mutual'; GlobalMart's one-way draft was turned into a mutual NDA on request. The Meridian NDA (one-way, signed within the hour as 'standard') is the counter-example.
findings.contract_quote: "Confidential Information" means all information, in any form, disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Company to the Recipient or its Representatives, whether before or after the Effective Date, including customer and portfolio data, credit models, product plans, pricing, technology architecture, business processes, and all analyses, compilations, notes or other documents prepared by the Recipient that contain or reflect such information.

findings.title: One-sided residuals clause — the other side may reuse what it learns from AtliQ
findings.explanation: Only Company may use 'Residuals' (anything its people remember, including ideas, know-how and techniques) for any purpose. AtliQ will be presenting its architecture and methods; this lets the counterparty use them freely while AtliQ stays bound. GlobalMart precedent: 'we'll be sharing our architecture too'.
findings.contract_quote: Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement, the Company shall be free to use Residuals for any purpose, including the development, marketing and procurement of products and services, provided that this Clause 4.1 does not grant any licence under any patent or copyright.

findings.title: New restrictive covenant on AtliQ (term + 12 months)
findings.explanation: This clause would restrict who AtliQ can work for — and it would join the commitments register. AtliQ has no list of what it has already promised not to do outside this tool; restrictions like this are how the Al Noor GCC non-compete came to block hospitality work. Check it against current clients and pipeline before signing (see Commitments).
findings.contract_quote: In order to protect the Confidential Information, the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

findings.title: No exclusion for independently developed information
findings.explanation: The standard carve-out for information the recipient develops independently is missing. Every signed AtliQ NDA has it; without it, AtliQ's own later work in the same space could be argued to be a breach.
findings.contract_quote: The obligations in Clause 2 shall not apply to information which the Recipient can demonstrate by contemporaneous written evidence:

findings.title: Confidentiality obligations last in perpetuity
findings.explanation: Obligations never end. AtliQ's signed NDAs run 3–5 years after the disclosure period (Al Noor 5 years, Harrington 3 years, LoopMart draft 3 years).
findings.contract_quote: The obligations of the Recipient under this Agreement shall survive termination and shall continue in perpetuity.

findings.title: One-way no-hire / non-solicit on AtliQ (term + 24 months)
findings.explanation: Only AtliQ is restricted from hiring the other side's people. AtliQ's signed client contracts use mutual employee non-solicits.
findings.contract_quote: The Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after its termination, directly or indirectly solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.
